meta.title: Illustrative electricity and manufacturing-process factors
meta.status: MIXED — technology-specific electricity factors are published IPCC AR5 medians; grid average, diesel, renewable mix and all process benchmarks are illustrative
meta.note: Published entries reproduce the IPCC AR5 WGIII Annex III lifecycle medians for one generation technology; they are not grid mixes and not location-specific. Process benchmarks are indicative specific-energy and scrap-rate figures used only to flag unusually high inputs; they are never added to the footprint.

units.emission_factor: kg CO2e per kWh of electricity
units.typical_energy: kWh per kg of finished product
units.typical_waste_pct: % of input material lost as scrap

energy_sources.name: Grid electricity (average mix)
energy_sources.basis: Illustrative; rounded figure near recent world-average grid intensity. Real grids range from under 0.05 to over 0.8 kg CO2e/kWh.

energy_sources.name: Coal-fired electricity
energy_sources.basis: IPCC AR5 WGIII (2014), Annex III, Table A.III.2 — lifecycle emissions median for pulverised coal (820 g CO2e/kWh; range 740-910).

energy_sources.name: Natural gas electricity
energy_sources.basis: IPCC AR5 WGIII (2014), Annex III, Table A.III.2 — lifecycle emissions median for gas combined cycle (490 g CO2e/kWh; range 410-650).

energy_sources.name: Renewable electricity (mixed)
energy_sources.basis: Illustrative blend; sits inside the IPCC AR5 lifecycle medians for wind (11), hydro (24) and solar PV (41-48 g CO2e/kWh).

energy_sources.name: On-site solar PV
energy_sources.basis: IPCC AR5 WGIII (2014), Annex III, Table A.III.2 — lifecycle emissions median for rooftop solar PV (41 g CO2e/kWh; range 26-60).

energy_sources.name: Wind power
energy_sources.basis: IPCC AR5 WGIII (2014), Annex III, Table A.III.2 — lifecycle emissions median for onshore wind (11 g CO2e/kWh; range 7-56).

energy_sources.name: Hydropower
energy_sources.basis: IPCC AR5 WGIII (2014), Annex III, Table A.III.2 — lifecycle emissions median for hydropower (24 g CO2e/kWh; highly site-dependent, range 1-2200).
